source: Liverpool Yacht Club Sailing Instructions 2025 v2 (published 4 April 2025) section 8, and Notice of Race 2025 v1 section 11
notes: LYC publishes no fixed courses. River courses are set on the day from the marks list (order of marks, rounding sides and laps), displayed in the lock or given on VHF 37 (SI 8.1.1), so every LYC race is a made-up course. Long races (Isle of Man Midnight Race, OS series, Lyver Trophy) have their own sailing instructions and are not included.
